question: What supreme attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together
Great accomplishment is the stated attainment
The yoginīs are the ones pleased
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
